overall: The AG found both December 22 notice items sufficiently specific, so the Fall River Redevelopment Authority did not violate the Open Meeting Law; the complaint was resolved by informal action.

allegations.summary: Complaint alleged the notice item 'Approval of a proposal for an appraisal for 45 Anawan Street' was too vague, lacking appraisal price and company names.
allegations.key_passage: We find that the topic “Approval of a proposal for an appraisal for 45 Anawan Street” was sufficiently specific to make the public aware of the discussion at the Board’s December 22 meeting.

allegations.summary: Complaint alleged the notice item 'Approval of City Pier Construction Requisition #2' was insufficiently specific.
allegations.key_passage: Therefore, we find that the Board’s discussion was sufficiently described by the item “Approval of City Pier Construction Requisition #2” because it reasonably informed the public of the discussion which was anticipated for the Board’s December 22 meeting.
